caption_L1: Total fertility rate in Bulgaria from 1875 to 2020 is a line graph. A linear scale of range 0 to 6 can be found along the y-axis, marked Fertility rate. A linear scale from 1880 to 2000 can be seen along the x-axis, marked Year.
caption_L2L3: Fertility rates reached a peak from an initially high level in 1905 and have since then been in fairly steep decline through to the 2000s. The fertility rates into the 21st century have started to climb a small amount.
